testsuite.name: com.textpic.studio.data.license.LicenseServiceTest

testcase.name: an unsigned or forged reply is rejected
a key for another phone is refused with the right sentence
device code is stable and formatted
a server error never locks a paying customer
no internet means no activation and nothing stored
a forged reply during a refresh never unlocks and never locks
a closed clock jump is caught on the next decision
removing the license forgets the key
block, cancel and expiry lock immediately
a signed ACTIVE reply activates the phone and stores the key
an unreachable server explains itself instead of blaming the internet
the device code in the stored snapshot matches the phone
an activated license keeps working offline for a week
the server call happens off the main thread
the quota from the server reaches the gate
